Container.Name: itemized
Container.Overview: Self-hosted household inventory management, expiration tracking, automatic shopping lists, mobile and USB barcode/QR scanning, and direct LAN Zebra ZPL label printing (IPP and Raw TCP 9100). Ships as a lightweight Go binary with an embedded web UI and single SQLite database, with OpenFoodFacts UPC lookup, optional LLM classification (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama), and optional OIDC SSO.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: inventory pantry fridge freezer grocery shopping barcode qr zebra zpl label expiration grocy
Container.Requires: Serve over HTTPS behind a reverse proxy (with TRUST_PROXY=true and BASE_URL set) to enable live mobile camera barcode scanning.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the Itemized Web UI and API.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the SQLite database (itemized.db).

Config.Name: Base URL
Config.Description: Public URL encoded into printed QR labels (e.g. https://itemized.example.com).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for running Itemized and owning /data files (99 = nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for running Itemized and owning /data files (100 = users on Unraid).

Config.Name: Trust Proxy Headers
Config.Description: Set to true when behind a reverse proxy so rate limiting reads X-Forwarded-For / X-Real-IP.

Config.Name: OIDC Issuer
Config.Description: Optional OIDC provider issuer URL (Auth Code + PKCE).

Config.Name: OIDC Auto-Provision
Config.Description: Set to true to auto-create household member accounts on first OIDC login.

Config.Name: OIDC Force Login
Config.Description: Set to true to require OIDC sign-in (redirects login page to IdP and disables local password login).

Config.Name: LLM Provider
Config.Description: Optional LLM provider for UPC normalization: anthropic, openai, gemini, or openai-compatible (e.g. Ollama).

Config.Name: LLM Base URL
Config.Description: Optional custom LLM API base URL (e.g. http://ollama:11434/v1).

Config.Name: LLM API Key
Config.Description: Optional API key for the configured LLM provider.
